visual_brief.subject: Claude Extraction You Can Check: Validation, Batches and Human Review
verified_context: An invoice says EUR 10.00. The extractor returns EUR 99.99, with 99% confidence. Every property has the right type. The amount is still wrong.
A schema accepts an integer 9999; a source check rejects it when the invoice says 1000 cents.
Persistent errors, low confidence and provider stops go to review.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: An apparently finished object must still be checked against evidence before acceptance.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A pale stone block rests beside a terracotta checking gauge whose opening does not match its shape.
visual_brief.output_crop: wide 16:9 master, center-safe for 21:9 desktop hero, 16:9 mobile hero and 3:2 cards
must_show: visible mismatch between block and gauge opening

candidate_provenance.prompt: Candidate A. Create one editorial illustration for The Daily AI Pulse. Placement: article-hero, wide 16:9 master. Subject: Claude Extraction You Can Check: Validation, Batches and Human Review. Verified context: A synthetic invoice extractor can return a well-shaped JSON record with a wrong amount and 99 percent claimed confidence. The application checks the record against independent source anchors and routes persistent errors to human review. Visual idea: a pale stone rectangular block rests beside an upright terracotta checking gauge with a circular opening visibly too small and the wrong shape for that block. One concrete physical metaphor for an apparently finished object failing an evidence check. The block is clearly outside the opening, never forced into it. Spacious three-quarter still life, subtle material depth, one sculptural terra-cotta gauge and one pale stone block, absolutely no other props. Center the relationship inside the central 55 percent so it survives 21:9 desktop and 3:2 card crops. Restrained contemporary editorial illustration with quiet scientific and architectural sensibility, deliberate geometry, fine edges, tactile paper and stone textures. Warm canvas #F3EBDD, paper #FAF6EE, near-black ink #171B1A, muted gray #575D5B, sparing terracotta #8A4B35. Background warm ivory, soft light, subtle depth, illustrated materiality, confident negative space. Publication references are physical folded paper in terracotta sorting form and stone inspection artifacts; keep their tactile editorial quality, do not copy their exact arrangement. This is artwork for an existing page, never a webpage. Not a bare schematic, flowchart, wireframe, icon composition or minimalist architecture diagram. NO words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, interface elements, page header/footer, buttons, badges, charts, watermark, neon, robots, glowing brains, screenshots, border or frame. High resolution, horizontal wide image.
